NASB.1: The righteous man perishes, and no man takes it to heart; And devout men are taken away, while no one understands. For the righteous man is taken away from evil,
NASB.2: He enters into peace; They rest in their beds, [Each one] who walked in his upright way.
NASB.3: 'But come here, you sons of a sorceress, Offspring of an adulterer and a prostitute.
NASB.4: 'Against whom do you jest? Against whom do you open wide your mouth And stick out your tongue? Are you not children of rebellion, Offspring of deceit,
NASB.5: [Who] inflame yourselves among the oaks, Under every luxuriant tree, Who slaughter the children in the ravines, Under the clefts of the crags?
NASB.6: 'Among the smooth [stones] of the ravine Is your portion, they are your lot; Even to them you have poured out a drink offering, You have made a grain offering. Shall I relent concerning these things?
NASB.7: 'Upon a high and lofty mountain You have made your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.
NASB.8: 'Behind the door and the doorpost You have set up your sign; Indeed, far removed from Me, you have uncovered yourself, And have gone up and made your bed wide. And you have made an agreement for yourself with them, You have loved their bed, You have looked on [their] manhood.
NASB.9: 'You have journeyed to the king with oil And increased your perfumes; You have sent your envoys a great distance And made [them] go down to Sheol.
NASB.10: 'You were tired out by the length of your road, [Yet] you did not say, 'It is hopeless.' You found renewed strength, Therefore you did not faint.
NASB.11: 'Of whom were you worried and fearful When you lied, and did not remember Me Nor give [Me] a thought? Was I not silent even for a long time So you do not fear Me?
NASB.12: 'I will declare your righteousness and your deeds, But they will not profit you.
NASB.13: 'When you cry out, let your collection [of idols] deliver you. But the wind will carry all of them up, [And] a breath will take [them away]. But he who takes refuge in Me will inherit the land And will possess My holy mountain.'
NASB.14: And it will be said, 'Build up, build up, prepare the way, Remove [every] obstacle out of the way of My people.'
NASB.15: For thus says the high and exalted One Who lives forever, whose name is Holy, 'I dwell [on] a high and holy place, And [also] with the contrite and lowly of spirit In order to revive the spirit of the lowly And to revive the heart of the contrite.
NASB.16: 'For I will not contend forever, Nor will I always be angry; For the spirit would grow faint before Me, And the breath [of those whom] I have made.
NASB.17: 'Because of the iniquity of his unjust gain I was angry and struck him; I hid [My face] and was angry, And he went on turning away, in the way of his heart.
NASB.18: 'I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will lead him and restore comfort to him and to his mourners,
NASB.19: Creating the praise of the lips. Peace, peace to him who is far and to him who is near,' Says the LORD, 'and I will heal him.'
NASB.20: But the wicked are like the tossing sea, For it cannot be quiet, And its waters toss up refuse and mud.
NASB.21: 'There is no peace,' says my God, 'for the wicked.'

NKJV.1: The righteous perishes, And no man takes it to heart; Merciful men are taken away, While no one considers That the righteous is taken away from evil.
NKJV.2: He shall enter into peace; They shall rest in their beds, Each one walking in his uprightness.
NKJV.3: “But come here,  You sons of the sorceress, You offspring of the adulterer and the harlot!
NKJV.4: Whom do you ridicule? Against whom do you make a wide mouth And stick out the tongue? Are you not children of transgression, Offspring of falsehood,
NKJV.5: Inflaming yourselves with gods under every green tree,  Slaying the children in the valleys, Under the clefts of the rocks?
NKJV.6: Among the smooth stones of the stream Is your portion; They, they, are your lot! Even to them you have poured a drink offering, You have offered a grain offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
NKJV.7: “On  a lofty and high mountain You have set your bed; Even there you went up To offer sacrifice.
NKJV.8: Also behind the doors and their posts You have set up your remembrance; For you have uncovered yourself to those other than Me, And have gone up to them; You have enlarged your bed And made a covenant with them; You have loved their bed, Where you saw their nudity.
NKJV.9: You went to the king with ointment, And increased your perfumes; You sent your messengers far off, And even descended to Sheol.
NKJV.10: You are wearied in the length of your way; Yet you did not say, ‘There is no hope.’ You have found the life of your hand; Therefore you were not grieved.
NKJV.11: “And of whom have you been afraid, or feared, That you have lied And not remembered Me, Nor taken it to your heart? Is it not because I have held My peace from of old That you do not fear Me?
NKJV.12: I will declare your righteousness And your works, For they will not profit you.
NKJV.13: When you cry out, Let your collection of idols deliver you. But the wind will carry them all away, A breath will take them. But he who puts his trust in Me shall possess the land, And shall inherit My holy mountain.”
NKJV.14: And one shall say,  “Heap it up! Heap it up! Prepare the way, Take the stumbling block out of the way of My people.”
NKJV.15: For thus says the High and Lofty One Who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in the high and holy place, With him who has a contrite and humble spirit, To revive the spirit of the humble, And to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
NKJV.16: For I will not contend forever, Nor will I always be angry; For the spirit would fail before Me, And the souls which I have made.
NKJV.17: For the iniquity of his covetousness I was angry and struck him;  I hid and was angry,  And he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.
NKJV.18: I have seen his ways, and will heal him; I will also lead him, And restore comforts to him And to his mourners.
NKJV.19: “I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace to him who is far off and to him who is near,” Says the LORD, “And I will heal him.”
NKJV.20: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, When it cannot rest, Whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
NKJV.21: “There is no peace,” Says my God, “for the wicked.”

ESV.1: The righteous man perishes, and no one lays it to heart; devout men are taken away, while no one understands. For the righteous man is taken away from calamity;
ESV.2: he enters into peace; they rest in their beds who walk in their uprightness.
ESV.3: But you, draw near, sons of the sorceress, offspring of the adulterer and the loose woman.
ESV.4: Whom are you mocking? Against whom do you open your mouth wide and stick out your tongue? Are you not children of transgression, the offspring of deceit,
ESV.5: you who burn with lust among the oaks,  under every green tree, who slaughter your children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
ESV.6: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion; they, they, are your lot; to them you have poured out a drink offering, you have brought a grain offering. Shall I relent for these things?
ESV.7: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed, and there you went up to offer sacrifice.
ESV.8: Behind the door and the doorpost you have set up your memorial; for, deserting me, you have uncovered your bed, you have gone up to it, you have made it wide; and you have made a covenant for yourself with them, you have loved their bed, you have looked on nakedness.
ESV.9: You journeyed to the king with oil and multiplied your perfumes; you sent your envoys far off, and sent down even to Sheol.
ESV.10: You were wearied with the length of your way, but you did not say, “It is hopeless”; you found new life for your strength, and so you were not faint.
ESV.11: Whom did you dread and fear, so that you lied, and did not remember me, did not lay it to heart? Have I not held my peace, even for a long time, and you do not fear me?
ESV.12: I will declare your righteousness and your deeds, but they will not profit you.
ESV.13: When you cry out, let your collection of idols deliver you! The wind will carry them all off, a breath will take them away. But he who takes refuge in me shall possess the land and shall inherit my holy mountain.
ESV.14: And it shall be said, “Build up, build up, prepare the way, remove every obstruction from my people's way.”
ESV.15: For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in the high and holy place, and also with him who is of a contrite and lowly spirit, to revive the spirit of the lowly, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
ESV.16: For I will not contend forever, nor will I always be angry; for the spirit would grow faint before me, and the breath of life that I made.
ESV.17: Because of the iniquity of his unjust gain I was angry, I struck him; I hid my face and was angry, but he went on backsliding in the way of his own heart.
ESV.18: I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will lead him and restore comfort to him and his mourners,
ESV.19: creating the fruit of the lips. Peace, peace, to the far and to the near,” says the LORD, “and I will heal him.
ESV.20: But the wicked are like the tossing sea; for it cannot be quiet, and its waters toss up mire and dirt.
ESV.21: There is no peace,” says my God, “for the wicked.”

WEB.1: The righteous perish, and no one lays it to heart. Merciful men are taken away, and no one considers that the righteous is taken away from the evil.
WEB.2: He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.
WEB.3: “But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring  of adulterers and prostitutes.
WEB.4: Whom do you mock? Against whom do you make a wide mouth, and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience, and offspring  of falsehood,
WEB.5: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
WEB.6: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion; they, they are your lot. You have even poured a drink offering to them. You have offered an offering. Shall I be appeased for these things?
WEB.7: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.
WEB.8: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts; for you have exposed yourself to someone besides me, and have gone up; you have enlarged your bed, and made you a covenant with them. You loved what you saw on their bed.
WEB.9: You went to the king with oil, and increased your perfumes, and sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol.
WEB.10: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.
WEB.11: “Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I held my peace for a long time, and you don’t fear me?
WEB.12: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they will not benefit you.
WEB.13: When you cry, let those whom you have gathered deliver you; but the wind will take them. a breath will carry them all away: but he who takes refuge in me will possess the land, and will inherit my holy mountain.”
WEB.14: He will say, “Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.”
WEB.15: For thus says the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
WEB.16: For I will not contend forever, neither will I be always angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls whom I have made.
WEB.17: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness, and struck him; I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.
WEB.18: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.
WEB.19: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says Yahweh; “and I will heal them.”
WEB.20: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest, and its waters cast up mire and mud.
WEB.21: “There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”

NLT.1:
Good people pass away;
the godly often die before their time.
But no one seems to care or wonder why.
No one seems to understand
that God is protecting them from the evil to come.
NLT.2:
For those who follow godly paths
will rest in peace when they die.
NLT.3:
“But you — come here, you witches’ children,
you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!
NLT.4:
Whom do you mock,
making faces and sticking out your tongues?
You children of sinners and liars!
NLT.5:
You worship your idols with great passion
beneath the oaks and under every green tree.
You sacrifice your children down in the valleys,
among the jagged rocks in the cliffs.
NLT.6:
Your gods are the smooth stones in the valleys.
You worship them with liquid offerings and grain offerings.
They, not I, are your inheritance.
Do you think all this makes me happy?
NLT.7:
You have committed adultery on every high mountain.
There you have worshiped idols
and have been unfaithful to me.
NLT.8:
You have put pagan symbols
on your doorposts and behind your doors.
You have left me
and climbed into bed with these detestable gods.
You have committed yourselves to them.
You love to look at their naked bodies.
NLT.9:
You have gone to Molech
with olive oil and many perfumes,
sending your agents far and wide,
even to the world of the dead.
NLT.10:
You grew weary in your search,
but you never gave up.
Desire gave you renewed strength,
and you did not grow weary.
NLT.11:
“Are you afraid of these idols?
Do they terrify you?
Is that why you have lied to me
and forgotten me and my words?
Is it because of my long silence
that you no longer fear me?
NLT.12:
Now I will expose your so-called good deeds.
None of them will help you.
NLT.13:
Let’s see if your idols can save you
when you cry to them for help.
Why, a puff of wind can knock them down!
If you just breathe on them, they fall over!
But whoever trusts in me will inherit the land
and possess my holy mountain.”
NLT.14:
God says, “Rebuild the road!
Clear away the rocks and stones
so my people can return from captivity.”
NLT.15:
The high and lofty one who lives in eternity,
the Holy One, says this:
“I live in the high and holy place
with those whose spirits are contrite and humble.
I restore the crushed spirit of the humble
and revive the courage of those with repentant hearts.
NLT.16:
For I will not fight against you forever;
I will not always be angry.
If I were, all people would pass away —
all the souls I have made.
NLT.17:
I was angry,
so I punished these greedy people.
I withdrew from them,
but they kept going on their own stubborn way.
NLT.18:
I have seen what they do,
but I will heal them anyway!
I will lead them.
I will comfort those who mourn,
NLT.19:
bringing words of praise to their lips.
May they have abundant peace, both near and far,”
says the LORD, who heals them.
NLT.20:
“But those who still reject me are like the restless sea,
which is never still
but continually churns up mud and dirt.
NLT.21:
There is no peace for the wicked,”
says my God.
